statusLegend.listed: The provider's own page lists this country as supported.
statusLegend.not-excluded: The country is not on the provider's published list of unsupported countries.
statusLegend.invite-only: The provider says new accounts from this country are invite-only.
statusLegend.label-only: The provider lists the country with a label it does not explain on that page. Ask the provider what it means for you.
statusLegend.conditional: Supported only under conditions described in the note.
statusLegend.grandfathered-only: Only existing merchants are kept. New merchants from this country are not eligible.
statusLegend.not-listed: The country does not appear on the provider's supported list.
statusLegend.prohibited: The provider names this country on its prohibited list.
statusLegend.unknown: We could not verify this on the provider's own site.

providers.name: Paddle
providers.summary: Merchant of record for software businesses. Paddle publishes a list of countries it cannot work with rather than a list of countries it supports.

facts.label: Seller countries
facts.value: Sellers from anywhere except a published list of unsupported countries and regions, including Afghanistan, Belarus, Burma (Myanmar), Cuba, Iran, Iraq, Mali, North Korea, Russia, Syria, Venezuela, Yemen, Zimbabwe and five regions of Ukraine.

facts.label: Fee
facts.value: 5% + 50 cents per checkout transaction, no monthly fees, migration fees or hidden extras. Custom pricing for high-volume or low-value transactions and for products under $10.

facts.label: Product type
facts.value: Paddle says it works with software businesses.

facts.label: Payouts
facts.value: Monthly. Balances over your threshold (minimum $100) convert on the 1st and are sent by the 15th, by wire transfer or Payoneer. No on-demand withdrawals.

facts.label: Payout fees
facts.value: No Paddle fee beyond the sales fee. A wire in a currency different from your bank country goes by SWIFT for $15 (or 15 euros or pounds). Up to 1.5% conversion margin if paid out in a currency other than your balance currency.

facts.label: Product rules
facts.value: Built for software companies, including B2B SaaS, consumer software and games. Prohibits physical products, human services unrelated to software, and a long list of forbidden categories on the AUP page (last updated 13 April 2026 on that page).

facts.label: Subscription surcharge
facts.value: None listed on the pricing page. Subscriptions are included in the all-inclusive checkout fee description.

facts.label: Setup fee
facts.value: Brazil: registration fee at sign-up. India: no extra charge to get account details. Most other regions: free to sign up, with a fee to get account details that depends on where the business is registered. Wise's US blog (updated 31 July 2026) states 31 USD one-time for US businesses. Check Wise's pricing page for your amount.
